name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation generated 0 leads from $124.78 in Meta spend over 28 days despite 251 clicks, triggering a lead drought flag that points to a likely landing page or form conversion issue. Spend surged 224% in the last 7 days (led by the "WARM-RETARGETING" campaign at $54.13) while GBP actions dropped 63%, suggesting budget is scaling on paid with no downstream results and organic visibility is simultaneously fading.

performance.verdict: Zero leads from $124.78 spent; 9 overdue milestones confirm build never launched.

findings.text: 251 Meta clicks and $124.78 spent over 28 days produced 0 leads and 0 GA4 conversions — confirmed conversion layer failure, not an audience problem.
5 milestones due 2026-07-31 are overdue by 44 days: pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account & CAPI, and landing pages & tracking — all undelivered.
4 further milestones due 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 also undelivered: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and nurture sequences — Phase 1 build effectively at 0% execution.
3-day spend signal (Sep 10–12: $16.74, $11.87, $6.63) is decelerating after a Sep 9 peak of $19.38 — WARM-RETARGETING pacing is slowing, but leads remain 0 throughout.
GBP actions dropped 63% in 7 days; last 3 days in series show 0 actions versus a 28-day average of ~3.2/day — GBP triage milestone being overdue is the direct cause.

suggestions.text: Pause WARM-RETARGETING spend immediately until landing page and conversion tracking are confirmed live per F1.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause the WARM-RETARGETING campaign (currently the only active campaign, $54.13 of $124.78 spent) until the landing pages & tracking milestone is completed and a test conversion fires end-to-end. Zero leads from 251 clicks over 28 days confirms the issue is post-click, not audience. Success check: one confirmed test lead appearing in GHL before any spend resumes. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; gate any new ad spend on pre-launch stack test passing per F2 and F3.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine milestones are overdue — five since 2026-07-31, four since 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 — with no completion events recorded. Nacer (Ops) must provide updated delivery dates for each. No paid budget should run against any channel until the end-to-end stack test (pre-launch milestone, Ops) is signed off. Success check: written milestone status update from Nacer by 2026-09-16.
